answer.reason: The verses give two events for this high priest: he obeyed the LORD's word and worked on the temple, and in Zechariah's vision his filthy garments were replaced and a mitre set on his head.

clauses.english: obeyed the LORD's word and came to work on the house of the LORD
clauses.quote: they came and did work in the house of the LORD of hosts, their God

clauses.english: was cleansed of his filthy garments and clothed with fair raiment and a mitre in a vision
clauses.quote: Take away the filthy garments from him.

doubts: ZEC 6:11 (crowns set on Joshua's head) is a command in a prophecy, not stated as done, so it was not used.
The vision in ZEC 3 is cited with verses 4-5, which are context, since they state the clothing.
